name: CAB multistep (corrected Adams-Bashforth)
plain: Sigma-space Adams-Bashforth with variable-step weights, plus a defect correction comparing the current velocity against a linear extrapolation of history.
math: v=(x−x0)/max(σ,1e−4). x_pred=x+Σ w_k v_k, w from compute_ab_weights(dt,past,p). If 2+ history and θ>0: r=h₁/h₂; v_e=(1+r)v₋₁−r·v₋₂; x_next=x_pred+θ·dt·(v−v_e). Defaults order 2, θ=0.2.
